نعتنق (form VIII)
# نَعْتَنِقُ (naʕtaniqu) /naʕ.ta.ni.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَنَقَ (iʕtanaqa)
# نُعْتَنَقُ (nuʕtanaqu) /nuʕ.ta.na.qu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَنَقَ (iʕtanaqa)
# نَعْتَنِقَ (naʕtaniqa) /naʕ.ta.ni.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَنَقَ (iʕtanaqa)
# نُعْتَنَقَ (nuʕtanaqa) /nuʕ.ta.na.qa/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
